clue.text: Trial I abandoned during film of one worshipping war

indicators.note: one piece sits during, i.e. within the span of, the other

parts.note: a film is a thin layer, such as a mist on glass

indicators.note: done in an abandoned, wild manner, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A war-loving character's court case collapses while a film about them is being made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' looks like a movie but is a thin haze; 'abandoned' signals the rearrangement and 'during' the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A militarist glorifies armed force and wants it to drive policy, a fair cryptic picture of someone who worships war.

clue.text: Damages bar?

definitions.meaning: to damage something is to spoil or blemish it
a well-known chocolate bar; the question mark flags the brand name

explanation.walkthrough: The Mars bar is a chocolate bar sold across Britain; the answer is also the Roman war god, a theme running through this puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: To spoil is a plain synonym for the verb, and the chocolate brand completes the bar.

clue.text: Ponderous fish brown on the inside

indicators.note: one piece is placed on the inside of the other

parts.note: the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family
umber is an earthy brown pigment

explanation.surface: A heavy, slow fish with a brown interior.
explanation.definitionFit: Ponderous and the answer both describe moving heavily and clumsily, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Maybe future cardinals expect to be introduced

parts.note: cardinal numbers such as ten; tens are a set of them

indicators.note: the word expect is introduced, i.e. only its opening letter is used

explanation.surface: Church cardinals look ahead to being presented to someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinals' suggests churchmen but means cardinal numbers; 'to be introduced' takes the first letter of 'expect'.
explanation.definitionFit: The future is one grammatical tense, so 'maybe future' defines by example.

clue.text: Essentially doubts parts without money

indicators.note: without here means outside, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: an actor's parts are roles

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its heart, so the central letters of doubts are taken

explanation.surface: Someone doubts that taking acting parts is possible when they have no money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of 'outside', and 'Essentially' takes the central pair of letters of 'doubts'.
explanation.definitionFit: Russian currency units, so an instance of money.

clue.text: Special present: square balls

parts.note: to be present is to be here
S stands for square in some abbreviations, such as sq ft shortened further

explanation.surface: A special gift: square-shaped balls, an impossibility.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface jokes about square balls, which cannot exist; 'square' only supplies a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Round solid bodies, globes and orbs, are spheres, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Getting close with weapon

parts.note: an arm is a weapon, as in firearms

explanation.surface: Someone closing in while carrying a weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: In the children's hunting game, players are told they are warm as they approach the hidden object.
explanation.definitionFit: In guessing and hunting games the word means near the target, so it fits getting close idiomatically.

clue.text: Waste recycling protects flower

indicators.note: the words waste recycling protect, i.e. hold inside them, the letters wanted

explanation.surface: Recycling waste helps safeguard flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recycling' looks like an anagram signal, but the letters lie in order across 'wASTE Recycling'.
explanation.definitionFit: A daisy-like garden bloom, so an example of a flower.

clue.text: War god inspires a feature of liqueur

indicators.note: to inspire is literally to breathe in, so one piece takes the other inside it

parts.note: Mars is the Roman god of war
the chin is a facial feature
o' is a shortened form of of, as in will-o'-the-wisp

explanation.surface: The god of war breathes life into a characteristic of some liqueur.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspires' puts A inside MARS; 'of' gives O, as in jack-o'-lantern.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet cherry-flavoured spirit from Dalmatia, so a type of liqueur.

clue.text: Large number possibly guilty about war god

indicators.note: one piece goes about, i.e. around, the other

parts.note: a plea in court may be guilty or not guilty
Thor, the Norse thunder god, was also invoked in battle

explanation.surface: Many people may be guilty concerning a god of war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly guilty' is a definition by example of a plea, which goes around THOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A glut or excess is a large number of things, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Type of republican country

parts.note: Oman is a country on the Arabian Peninsula

explanation.surface: Describing the kind of nation that is a republic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Type' looks like 'kind', but it is printing: the upright typeface.
explanation.definitionFit: Upright print is a standard typeface, contrasted with italic, so it is a kind of type.

clue.text: Raised weapon store something to do with furniture

parts.note: something raised is up
a holster is a case that stores a pistol

explanation.surface: A raised gun-case somehow relates to furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: To pad and cover chairs and sofas is a job done to furniture, so the vague phrase fits.

clue.text: Party girl, one missing wake- up call gets second serving of breakfast

indicators.note: missing means the numeral is lacking from the call

parts.note: reveille is the bugle call waking soldiers
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the second serving, here the second letter, of breakfast is taken

explanation.surface: A party girl sleeps through her alarm but still gets a second helping of breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' drops I from REVEILLE, leaving REVELLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A partygoer who makes merry, and here a woman one, so it suits party girl.

clue.text: Goes right through barrels

indicators.note: one piece runs through the middle of the other

parts.note: a tun is a large cask or barrel

explanation.surface: Someone takes a right turn through some barrels.
explanation.definitionFit: As nouns both mean an opportunity to play, as in 'whose go is it?', so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Premonition about first to back war god in poor visibility

indicators.note: the pieces sit in the other one

parts.note: fog brings poor visibility
re means about, concerning

indicators.note: the first letter of the word back is taken

parts.note: Odin is the chief Norse god, a god of war

explanation.surface: A sense of doom about being first to support a war god in thick fog.
explanation.walkthrough: RE, B and ODIN go 'in' FOG.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeling that something bad is coming is a premonition, a synonym.

clue.text: Presbyopia testing involves drugs

indicators.note: the words presbyopia testing involve, or contain, the letters wanted

explanation.surface: An eye test for long-sightedness brings in the use of drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: Presbyopia is age-related long-sightedness; the letters run across 'presbyOPIA TESting'.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcotics derived from opium are drugs, so the definition gives the general class.

clue.text: Unexpectedly strained exchanges

indicators.note: something done unexpectedly comes out in a surprising form, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Diplomatic exchanges that turned tense without warning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchanges' looks like a noun for conversations, but it is the verb: to hand in an old item as part payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Handing over an old car as part payment for a new one is a phrasal verb meaning swapping, so it fits as exchanges.

clue.text: Bear advanced on cat in school

indicators.note: the pieces sit in the other one
on means placed after, so the letter follows the cat

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
A is an abbreviation for advanced, as in A level

explanation.surface: A cat in school gets moved up a year.
explanation.definitionFit: To tolerate or put up with something is to bear it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Spoke to Bill, wearing clothes

parts.note: an ad, or advertisement, is a bill posted up
someone wearing clothes is dressed

explanation.surface: A man called Bill was talked to while he had his clothes on.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking directly to someone is addressing them, so the past tense matches spoke to.

clue.text: Cricket team dash to get ball?

parts.note: an en dash is a printing dash the width of an n
slang for a testicle, which is a gland

explanation.surface: A cricket team rushes to fetch the ball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ball' looks like cricket but is slang for a testicle, a gland; the en dash is a typesetting term.
explanation.definitionFit: The national side playing Test cricket is named after its country, so it names a cricket team.

clue.text: War god confused about English widow

indicators.note: the jumble goes about, around, the letter
the words war god are confused, mixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: A war god is baffled about something English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' rearranges WARGOD into DOWAGR, which goes 'about' E.
explanation.definitionFit: A dowager is a widow holding a title or property from her late husband, so the answer is a kind of widow.

clue.text: African peacekeepers surround extremists in Guatemala

indicators.note: the peacekeepers surround the other piece

parts.note: UN peacekeepers are troops of the United Nations
the extreme letters of Guatemala are G and A, written out as words

explanation.surface: United Nations troops encircle extremists in a Central American country.
explanation.walkthrough: The extremes of 'Guatemala' are 'G and A', read literally as GANDA.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from a nation in East Africa is an African, so the definition is the broader class.

clue.text: Discover a French deer, heading down

parts.note: une is French for a, the feminine article

indicators.note: in a down answer the deer's first letter, its heading, moves down to the end

parts.note: a hart is a male red deer

explanation.surface: Finding a French deer with its head lowered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading down' moves the H of HART to the bottom, making ARTH.
explanation.definitionFit: To dig up or bring to light is to discover, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Game played in sombreros

indicators.note: the game is played inside the word sombreros, its letters lying within

explanation.surface: A game played by people wearing Mexican hats.
explanation.definitionFit: Ombre was a three-handed card game popular in the seventeenth century, an instance of a game.

clue.text: Established when apparently asleep

indicators.note: apparently suggests the word for when appears placed in bed, as a sleeper would be

parts.note: someone asleep is in bed, so the sleeper's place is a bed
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Something set up only when it seemed to be dozing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'asleep' is read as 'in bed', so 'apparently' asks the solver to picture the word for 'when' tucked up in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something based somewhere has its headquarters there, so it is established, a synonym.

clue.text: Persuaded to pay attention to lecturer in midweek

indicators.note: the pieces go in the other one

parts.note: Wednesday, Wed for short, is the middle of the week
to heed is to pay attention

explanation.surface: Talked into listening to a lecturer in the middle of the week.
explanation.definitionFit: Coaxed by flattery is a softer form of persuaded, so they are near synonyms.

clue.text: Nurse wearing stupid fabric

indicators.note: one piece wears the other, wrapped around it like clothing

parts.note: dim means stupid
EN is short for Enrolled Nurse

explanation.surface: A nurse in dumb-looking fabric clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A tough cotton twill used for jeans is a fabric, so the definition gives the class.

clue.text: Land measures Arkansas uses are un-American

parts.note: AR is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Arkansas

indicators.note: the letters standing for the US are removed from the word uses

explanation.surface: The ways Arkansas uses things are deemed un-American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'un-American' strips US from 'uses', leaving ES.
explanation.definitionFit: An are is a metric unit of area, a hundred square metres, so the plural names measures of land.

clue.text: Ball fitness regularly ignored by forward

indicators.note: by means beside, so the pieces stand side by side
every other letter of fitness is ignored, leaving the rest

parts.note: a winger is a forward player on a wing

explanation.surface: A footballer's fitness is routinely neglected by a forward.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping alternate letters of 'fitness' leaves INS. In cricket the answer is a delivery that swerves in towards the batsman.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a delivery that curves into the batter is a type of bowled ball, so this is definition by example.

clue.text: Unopened can returned? Definitely not in America

indicators.note: returned means the remaining letters are read backwards
unopened means the opening letter is taken off

parts.note: can is slang for prison

explanation.surface: A tin can sent back without being opened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' looks like a tin but is slang for jail; 'Unopened' leaves RISON, 'returned' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: An emphatic refusal, typical of American speech, so it fits a firm denial in the US.

clue.text: Work with detective high up in theatre

parts.note: to go is to work, as in 'the engine won't go'
DS is a Detective Sergeant

explanation.surface: Working alongside a detective in the upper reaches of a theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: In British theatres the topmost gallery, with the cheapest seats, is called this.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest balcony of a theatre is nicknamed for being nearest heaven, so it is high up in a theatre.

clue.text: Rang war god about scientist

indicators.note: the god goes about, around, the other piece

parts.note: Ares is the Greek god of war
a bell that rang chimed

explanation.surface: A war god phoned to ask about a scientist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rang' suggests a phone call but means a bell sounding.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Syracusan mathematician and inventor is a famous scientist, a definition by example.
